pages.title: Pulsar Timing Crystal
pages.text: A crystal that ticks with the precision of a millisecond pulsar, the most regular natural clocks known. Its pulses are so stable that any drift reveals a passing gravitational wave. It flashes a faint blue on every beat, and I set my watches by it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Neutron Star Forge I spun a Magnetar Shard up inside quartz, with a Chronon Capacitor to stabilise the rhythm. Neutrino Flux synchronised it with the stars, and the beat matched to the nanosecond.

Made in $(item)Neutron Star Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Pulsar Timing Ore$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Pulsar Wisp.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Pulsar Beacon chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compact Stars.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Causality Loop Engine, Chronal Accelerator, Exotic Matter Crystal, Horizon Containment, Multiverse Shard, Temporal Singularity.
